intro.title: About Us
intro.description: We are a leading nongovernmental organization that has been actively working for the upliftment of women, children, and marginalized communities in Siraha District, Madhesh Province for over 30 years. Since our establishment, we have been conducting various development and awareness programs for the social, economic, and political empowerment of Madhesi women as well as for the bright future of children.

programs.title: Our Programs
programs.subtitle: We run diverse programs for the upliftment of Madhesi communities.

women-empowerment.title: Women Empowerment
women-empowerment.summary: Developing leadership capacity in women, promoting legal literacy, and mobilizing savings and credit for economic self-reliance.

health-nutrition.title: Health and Nutrition
health-nutrition.summary: Reproductive health awareness, maternal and child safety, free health camps, and nutrition education in rural areas.

education-literacy.title: Education and Literacy
education-literacy.summary: School enrollment campaigns for girls, scholarship distribution, and ensuring access to quality education.

vocational-training.title: Vocational Training
vocational-training.summary: Skills-based training in sewing, handicrafts, beautician services, and modern agriculture to help women become self-reliant.

advocacy-justice.title: Advocacy and Justice
advocacy-justice.summary: Street theatre, legal aid, and advocacy against gender-based violence, child marriage, dowry, and witchcraft accusations.

child-development.title: Child Development
child-development.summary: Child-rights protection, reduction of child labor, and recreational and capacity-development programs for children.

achievements.title: Key Achievements
items: Thousands of women have become economically self-reliant through vocational training.
Campaigns against child marriage and dowry have significantly raised community awareness.
Hundreds of girls from disadvantaged families have been supported in completing their school education.
Meaningful participation of Madhesi women in local governance and decision-making has increased.
Health and education awareness programs have made a positive impact in communities.

background.title: Our Background
background.content: Over a 30-year journey, this organization has played a significant role in improving the living standards of women from rural and disadvantaged communities in Siraha. We have always been at the forefront of fighting against social ills such as patriarchal thinking, dowry practices, child marriage, and gender-based violence, and securing a respected place for women in society.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.content: To build an equitable and violence-free society where every Madhesi woman and child enjoys dignity, safety, and equal opportunity.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.content: To protect and advance the rights of Madhesi women and children through education, healthcare, skills development, and advocacy.
